Economy · India

India focuses on energy demand, clean manufacturing, and solar power

India is anticipating a significant increase in power demand, estimating it to reach 300 GW next year. To meet this, the government is backing local clean-energy manufacturing, particularly for EV and energy storage components, aiming to reduce import reliance. The World Bank is also supporting India's solar initiatives with substantial financing for rooftop solar programs.
